g.text: Peer-to-Peer Student Skill Exchange Platform • MCA Semester 1 Mini Project • Schema Specification v1.0
Stores student and administrator credentials, profiles, academic institution, and role-based access.
Unique primary identifier for user account
Full legal or display name of student / admin
💡 Relationships: 1-N user_skills, sent_requests, received_requests, given_ratings, received_ratings.
Standardized academic and technical taxonomy groupings for classifying platform skills.
Overview of subjects covered in this category
Bootstrap Icons CSS class for UI visual badge
💡 Relationships: 1-N skills (cascade delete-orphan). Pre-seeded categories: Programming, Database, Web Dev, etc.
Canonical catalogue of predefined and student-proposed skills available for peer exchange.
💡 Foreign Key: category_id -> skill_categories(id). Case-insensitive deduplication applied on new skills.
Junction table mapping student portfolios to skills with teaching/learning intent and proficiency.
Custom student notes, target frameworks, or topic focus
💡 Unique Constraint: uq_user_skill_type(user_id, skill_id, skill_type) prevents duplicate entries per intent.
Bilateral skill swap proposals initiated by one student to another with offered and requested skills.
Recipient peer student ID referencing users(id)
Skill sender wants to learn, referencing skills(id)
Introductory proposal message and schedule preferences
💡 Foreign Keys: sender_id, receiver_id -> users(id); offered_skill_id, requested_skill_id -> skills(id).
Scheduled learning meetings originating from accepted exchange requests.
Parent accepted request ID referencing exchange_requests(id)
Video call URL (Meet/Zoom) or physical campus room
Session agenda, study materials, or preparation topics
💡 Unique Constraint: request_id is UNIQUE (1-to-1 relationship with accepted exchange requests).
Mutual post-session peer ratings and qualitative reviews following completed sessions.
💡 Constraints: uq_session_reviewer UNIQUE(session_id, reviewer_id); ck_rating_score_range CHECK(score BETWEEN 1 AND 5).
SkillConnect Peer Skill Exchange Platform • MCA Semester 1 Project • Comprehensive Database Specification
